title: The Guilty Feminist
author: Deborah Frances-White
description: Ever felt like you should be better at feminism? Join comedian Deborah Frances-White and her guests for this comedy podcast, recorded in front of a live audience. Each week they discuss our noble goals as 21st century feminists and the hypocrisies and insecurities that undermine them. Deborah Frances-White is the 2016 Writers' Guild Award Winner for Best Radio Comedy for her hit BBC Radio 4 series Deborah Frances-White Rolls the Dice. She is an Edinburgh Fringe regular, a screenwriter and is in huge demand for her corporate seminars.

extraits.texte: I find this podcast a breath of hope in today’s frustratingly everlasting patriarchal world. This podcast gives me the courage to proudly say that I too am a feminist, and that I’m not alone.…

extraits.titre: Better than any kind of comfort food!
extraits.texte: Been binge listening to The Guilty Feminist since the beginning of lockdown and it’s been like I found a treasure ! Thank you so much from a French women who laughs out loud while cooking or redecorating the bathroom or gardening and the kids eyeballing their mother wondering how…

extraits.titre: Everyone I could every hope for
extraits.texte: I listen to this podcast way too much, I absolutely love it. It is inspirational, educational, informative, hilarious, kind, moving and just exactly what I want to listen to all day long. So refreshing to hear new, young, coloured, disbaled women providing the best comedy.…
